summary: This Makefile snippet checks whether a .env file exists in the current directory, and if it does, it includes (loads) that file so its variables are available to the rest of the Makefile. This is a common pattern for loading configuration from environment files.

explanations.1: wildcard is a Makefile function that expands to the list of files matching a pattern—here it looks for .env. The ifneq checks if the result is not equal to an empty string, meaning the file exists.
explanations.2: include tells Make to read and process another file as if its contents were written here, making any variables defined in .env available in this Makefile.
